input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Microsoft's operating margin for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 exceeded 45%. The counter-evidence provides the complete income statement figures for the three months ended December 31, 2025: Revenue of $81,273 million and Operating income of $38,275 million. This yields an operating margin of 47.09% ($38,275 / $81,273 = 0.4709), which exceeds the 45% threshold.

All three challenges were refuted:
H1: The numeric check confirms the operating margin was 47.09%, not below 45%.
H2: While impairment charges in the Gaming business were mentioned, they were part of the $587 million increase in R&D expenses and did not prevent the operating margin from exceeding 45%.
H3: Total operating expenses were $17,020 million on revenue of $81,273 million, representing only 21% of revenue, which combined with cost of revenue of $25,978 million (32% of revenue) results in the 47.09% operating margin.

The claim is fully supported by the financial data in the 10-Q filing for the quarter ended December 31, 2025.
